title: The bus, twice a day
logline: The Greyhound passing the town's stop on 101 without stopping, from the seawall, small, at 4:10. Nobody waiting. Eleven days before the Route North; the page watches the bus go north first.

panels.composition: A coastal highway from a seawall with a bus passing a roadside stop without slowing, the stop's sign and bench empty, gray sea.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a coastal highway seen from a seawall with a bus passing a roadside stop without slowing, the stop's sign and bench empty, gray sea beyond, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
